videos.title: Gen Z Moves Money From Stocks to Sports Bets
videos.description: Bloomberg's Zijia Song joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Sports betting is increasingly competing with traditional investing for younger Americans’ attention, with more than a quarter of Gen Z investors saying they see gambling on sports as part of their long-term financial strategy, according to a survey by personal finance platform Betterment. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
